title: Cross-task anchor metrics and robustness prober for quant profiles
creator: Rhea Patel
description: Design and implement an evaluation harness that computes cross-task anchor metrics and runs robustness probes for FP8/INT8 quantization profiles. The goal is to provide a single scoring matrix that combines reference-based metrics (ROUGE/BLEU), language-model style metrics (perplexity / calibrated likelihoods), and task-specific correctness (MMLU, QA exact match, classification F1), plus synthetic robustness probes (noise injection, prompt paraphrase, prefix truncation). The output will feed into the calibration workflow and be used as gating signals for rollout automation.
acceptance_criteria: 1) A runnable evaluation job that accepts a candidate quantized model and produces a per-task and aggregated scoring matrix within the runtime SLO (<= 3h for full suite on CI-sized sample); 2) Implementation of at least three metric adapters: perplexity (token-level), MMLU-style accuracy suite, and ROUGE/BLEU for summarization tasks; 3) Task-specific scorer plugin API documented with examples (QA EM, classification F1, summarization R1/R2/RL); 4) Baseline anchors established for float32 and existing INT8 profile; 5) Integration with CI such that PRs tagging quant profiles produce a report and pass/fail gating based on tolerances defined below.
technical_notes:
- Metric interface: scorer(plugin_name) -> batch_score(list_of_predictions, list_of_references, optional_metadata) returning flattened list of floats as CSV-friendly strings. Keep I/O simple for portability across runner infra.
- Perplexity: compute token-log-likelihood-based perplexity using model logits post-quantization; expose both raw perplexity and normalized perplexity relative to float baseline.
- MMLU-style: run stratified dataset sampling across subjects; compute per-subject accuracy and macro average. Add confidence-adjusted accuracy (calibrated via Platt scaling using a held-out calibration split).
- ROUGE/BLEU: use sacrebleu and rouge-score baseline implementations; capture recall/precision/F1 where applicable.
- Robustness probes: implement noise-injection harness (random token deletion, swap, subword corruption), prompt-paraphrase set (using back-translation shim), and KV-cache truncation simulation. Score degradations and compute delta-to-anchor.
- Aggregation: provide both conservative (min across tasks) and weighted-average (user weights via config) aggregation modes. Produce CSV and JSONL flattened rows for each job (but store only CSV/flat outputs in this ticket to keep schema simple).
- Resource notes: evaluation uses a mix of cpu/gpu runners; heavy metrics offloaded to CPU (sacrebleu), perplexity requires GPU for logits. Use 2x p3-equivalent nodes for full run estimate.
- Tolerances: default per-task tolerance set to: perplexity <= 1.05x float baseline, MMLU delta >= -1.5% absolute, summarization ROUGE-L >= -2.0 absolute. These are parameterized and overridable by PR labels.
